name: Samsung Tizen (web app)
note: Unsigned package root; sign it with your Samsung certificate profile (tizen package -t wgt).

name: Samsung Tizen (native)
note: Test-signed with the Tizen SDK default certificate; re-sign with your Samsung certificate profile to install on a retail TV.

name: LG webOS
note: Sideload with ares-install or Developer Mode.

name: Hisense VIDAA
note: No package: open the hosted Web App in the TV browser (docs/clients/vidaa.md).

name: Roku
note: Sideload channel zip (Roku developer mode). Roku Channel Store submission pending.

name: Fire TV (Vega OS)
note: Not built by the release: the Vega SDK installs only from an Amazon developer account inside a Docker image (clients/fire-tv/scripts/Dockerfile.vega-sdk). Typecheck and jest run in stage 1.

name: Fire OS / Android TV (APK)
note: The same universal APK as the phone and tablet build; sideload it.

name: Android phone and tablet (APK)
note: Signed sideload APK; updates itself from the update manifest.

name: Android (Google Play)
note: Closed testing track; join the test group first.

name: iPadOS
note: TestFlight beta (the iOS build runs on iPad).

name: macOS
note: Unsigned (no Developer ID yet): allow it in System Settings, Privacy and Security.

name: Xbox
note: Unsigned sideload package; sign it before installing in Xbox Dev Mode.

name: HarmonyOS
note: Unsigned HAP; sign it with your own AppGallery material.

name: Linux phone
note: GTK 4 and libadwaita binary with GStreamer (gtk4paintablesink); x86_64 only.

name: Sailfish OS
note: Not built by the release yet: the RPM needs the roughly 3 GB Sailfish SDK target, built in an unprivileged bubblewrap namespace (clients/sailfish/scripts/sdk-build.sh), unproven on a hosted runner; device RPMs (armv7hl, aarch64) also need qemu-user.
